SPORT WAGON
SPORT IN MORE than just name, the TSX Sport Wagon earns its badge with its
driver-focused cockpit, highly efficient engine and precise response. And if your
idea of sport includes more than taking on a challenging stretch of asphalt,
the TSX Sport Wagon offers plenty of cargo space for your gear. Its impressive
30-mpg highway rating1 also adds to the vehicle’s performance credentials.

Performance Technology Package
• 201-hp, 2.4-liter, 16-valve, DOHC i-VTEC® 4-cylinder engine (Adds to or replaces standard TSX features; included with V-6 Sedan)
• 280-hp, 3.5-liter, 24-valve, SOHC VTEC® V-6 engine (V-6 Sedan) • Acura Navigation System with Voice Recognition™ and rearview camera
• 5-speed automatic transmission with Sequential SportShift paddle shifters • Acura/ELS Surround® Premium Audio System with hard disk drive (HDD)
• Close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission (available Special Edition only) media storage and 10 speakers
• Front-wheel drive • AcuraLink Real-Time Traffic and Weather™4
• 4-wheel independent suspension: double wishbone front / multi-link rear • Traffic Rerouting™4
• Electric variable power-assisted rack-and-pinion steering (EPS) • GPS-linked, solar-sensing, dual-zone automatic climate control system
• 17-inch aluminum-alloy wheels with P225/50 R17 93V high-performance all-season tires • Song By Voice®
• 18-inch aluminum-alloy wheels with P235/45 R18 94V high-performance all-season tires (V-6 Sedan) • Remote-Linked, Power-Operated Tailgate (Sport Wagon)

• Advanced Compatibility Engineering™ (ACE™) body structure • EPA Fuel Economy Rating1 (City/Highway/Combined) AT: 22 | 31 | 26 MT: 21 | 29 | 24

• Fuel Tank Capacity 18.5 U.S. gallons
